description: This file defines a custom exception class 'BasketNotFoundException' used in the application core of the eShopOnWeb project, specifically within the Exceptions namespace. The exception is thrown when a basket with a specified id cannot be found.

classes.name: BasketNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception that indicates a basket was not found for a given id. Inherits from System.Exception and provides a constructor that accepts a basket id to generate a specific error message.

methods.name: BasketNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception message with the provided basket id.
